history.summary: A freehold 786 sqft 2BR in Kovan at $1.2M / $1,527 PSF, marginally under the $1,559 URA median. Decent fundamentals and a useful 2BR format, but Vibes @ Kovan is a small boutique block and the appreciation rate rests on only 12 transactions, so the case is solid-but-thin rather than compelling.
history.rating_rationale: Freehold and a broad-appeal 2BR are positives, and PSF is ~2% below the $1,559 median. But the +3.42%/yr URA CAGR comes from just 12 transactions (unreliable), and Vibes @ Kovan is a small freehold development with limited facilities and shallower liquidity. Serangoon MRT is 810m (10 min walk) — usable but not doorstep. Net: a fair, unexciting hold.
red_flags: Appreciation rate from only 12 URA txns — low confidence
Small boutique development — limited amenities and thinner resale liquidity
Serangoon MRT 810m away, not within tight walking distance
catalysts: Kovan/Serangoon mature estate with strong owner-occupier and tenant demand
2BR format has the widest buyer/tenant pool

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: 2BR in a mature Serangoon/Kovan estate rents reliably to young professionals and small families; freehold and walkable amenities support steady occupancy at a typical ~3-3.5% gross yield.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: URA shows +3.4%/yr but on a 12-txn base — treat as indicative only. Freehold city-fringe should track district averages; no specific catalyst to lift it above.
